facts.fact: Algeria's Minister of Justice announced on 22 September 2026 that the national electronic window for administrative jurisdictions now covers the administrative courts of appeal and the Council of State, letting litigants and their lawyers consult and track their cases and read the operative parts of judgments and decisions online from any administrative jurisdiction.
facts.system: guichet électronique national dédié aux juridictions administratives

systems.system: guichet électronique national dédié aux juridictions administratives
systems.tiers: administrative tribunals, administrative courts of appeal, Council of State

facts.fact: Fildalgerie reports that the Ministry of Justice is making electronic exchange of civil requests and reply briefs exclusive for lawyers at the Cours de justice from 18 January 2026, after wide uptake by lawyers.
facts.system: Electronic exchange of requests and briefs (civil, Cours de justice)

facts.fact: The president of the Cour d'Alger said on 10 November 2025 that, on Ministry of Justice instruction, the court has begun implementing an electronic exchange system for requests and documents in civil cases, a first step.
facts.system: Electronic exchange of civil requests and documents

systems.system: Electronic exchange of civil requests and documents
